newsitem.title: USA: Allen Group to acquire Signal Science.
newsitem.headline: Allen Group to acquire Signal Science.

text.p: Allen Group Inc said Wednesday that it signed a definitive contract to acquire 100 percent of Signal Science Inc with an expected closing before the end of the third quarter 1996.
Allen Group said in a release that Signal, a 22-year-old company based in Santa Clara, Calif., reported sales of $4.8 million in its fiscal year ended September 30, 1995.
Signal Science specializes in research and development projects and special-purpose radio signal equipment for telecommunications applications, Allen Group added.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
